profile_text: As a pharmacy located in Düsseldorf, this establishment has been providing healthcare services to the local community since 1961, operating with 13 employees as of 2024. Despite a 7.1% decline in growth, its categorization as a Gazelle indicates a history of rapid expansion, suggesting a strong foundation for potential future recovery. With a long-standing presence in the market, this pharmacy has established itself as a reliable provider of pharmaceutical products and services.
